name: Kai Yoshinao
source:
A fellow voice actor at Nadeshiko Productions.
He has a cute face, but he often speaks with harsh words, he's always obedient in front of the manager Higuchi however.
Opposite to [url=/c41181]Nagumo[/url] he doesn't seem to like his job that much.
